entry.title: OSC to MIDI 2.5.0
entry.summary: OSC to MIDI for Akai MPC (Gio Music). Turns OSC over Wi-Fi into MIDI notes and CCs. Install: unzip, copy the "Gio Music - VST - OSC to MIDI" folder into "VST2 Plugins" on your MPC drive, restart. Needs MPC OS 3.10.1+ with External Plugin Support enabled. Tested on MPC Live III.
